task_criteria: After a fresh fetch of origin, every run_id cited in board rows detail.evidence resolves to .gitreins/history/<date>/<run_id>/verdict.json in refs/gitreins/history or the working tree, measured by scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh committed to the repo; the script flags non-run-id shaped values.

items.criterion: After a fresh fetch of origin, every run_id cited in board rows detail.evidence resolves to .gitreins/history/<date>/<run_id>/verdict.json in refs/gitreins/history or the working tree, measured by scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh committed to the repo; the script flags non-run-id shaped values.
items.detail: Partially delivered. Script IS committed (scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh, commit 5b7a1e00; npm run audit:evidence-runids at package.json:36) and DOES flag non-run-id values — live run at HEAD 5224b938 (= origin/main) printed 'NOT-A-RUN-ID 43855424821 (all-decimal integer)', 'DF-SPECLANG-014', 'DF-SPECLANG-1-R4', 'UX-001', 'speclang-docs-2026-11-16-05-02-33-refire2', and a synthetic-board test confirmed MISSING/NOT-A-RUN-ID/exit-1 vs clean-board exit-0 behaviour. All 66 run-id-shaped cited values resolve in refs/gitreins/history (0 unresolvable). BUT the resolution goal is not met: the script exits 1 with 'total distinct values: 71 / not-a-run-id: 5 / resolvable 66/71' — the 5 non-run-id values still sit in board rows RELEASE-001, UX-001, DOC-9, DF-SPECLANG-014, DF-SPECLANG-1-R4, DF-SPECLANG-3 (verified via jq extraction), and the board's own documented audit command (EVID-1 detail.text) shows the same 5 cited values unresolvable in both the local ref (2fb9462a) and origin's ref (071ed739): comm -23 runids refids = exactly those 5. The claimed '63/63' matches no reproducible measurement (script: 66/71; documented command: 5 of 71 missing). Additionally the 'fresh fetch of origin' precondition is broken: 'git fetch origin refs/gitreins/history:refs/gitreins/history' is rejected non-fast-forward — origin carries 071ed739 (117 runs) while the local ref has diverged to 2fb9462a (122 runs, 5 newer verdict commits), so a fresh fetch never obtains the state under which the audit was measured. Finally the board row EVID-1 itself is still status=pending (.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl:180).

items.criterion: Derived: the committed audit script must exit 0 against the landed board per its own success contract (exit 0 = every cited value resolves AND no non-run-id-shaped values remain)
items.detail: sh scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh at HEAD 5224b938 exits 1: 'unresolvable run-ids: 0 / not-a-run-id: 5 / resolvable 66/71', EXIT=1. Commit 5b7a1e00's own message states 'Exit 0 therefore still requires the board rows to be repaired' — that repair never landed; the 5 bad values are still cited by rows RELEASE-001, UX-001, DOC-9, DF-SPECLANG-014, DF-SPECLANG-1-R4, DF-SPECLANG-3.

items.criterion: Derived: refs/gitreins/history on origin must contain the unioned history so a fresh fetch resolves cited run_ids (the criterion's explicit 'After a fresh fetch of origin' precondition)
items.detail: git ls-remote origin shows refs/gitreins/history = 071ed739 (117 runs); local ref = 2fb9462a (122 runs) with 5 newer verdict commits (52adea98..2fb9462a). 'git fetch origin refs/gitreins/history:refs/gitreins/history' → '! [rejected] (non-fast-forward)'. Even origin's ref lacks the 5 non-run-id cited values (comm -23 vs 071ed739 listing = same 5), so the audit cannot pass from a fresh fetch.

ls -la && git log --oneline -5 && git status
read_file {"path": "scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh"}
git ls-files scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh && git log --oneline -3 -- scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh

git rev-parse --verify refs/gitreins/history 2>&1; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---count---"; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history 2>/dev/null | wc -l
sh scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh; echo "EXIT=$?"
ls .gitreins/history/ 2>/dev/null; find .gitreins/history -name verdict.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l; wc -l .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
grep -n '43855424821\|DF-SPECLANG-014\|DF-SPECLANG-1-R4\|UX-001\|refire2' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | head -20

jq -r 'select(.detail|type=="object") | .id as $id | (.detail.evidence // []) | if type=="array" then (.[] | if type=="object" then (if .run_id == null then empty else "\($id)\t\(.run_id)" end) else empty end) else empty end' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | grep -P '\t(43855424821|DF-SPECLANG-014|DF-SPECLANG-1-R4|UX-001|speclang-docs-2026-11-16-05-02-33-refire2)$'
jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | {status, title, reasoning, acceptance, review_notes, completion_note, evidence: .detail.evidence}' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl

jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | keys' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ---; jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .detail | keys' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ---; jq -rj 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .detail.text' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
jq -rj 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .acceptance_criteria' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo; echo ---; jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .status, .updated_at' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
git fetch origin 2>&1 | tail -3; git rev-parse HEAD origin/main 2>&1; git log --oneline -1 origin/main 2>&1

jq -r 'select(.id=="RELEASE-001") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; jq -r 'select(.id=="UX-001") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; jq -r 'select(.id=="DOC-9") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; jq -r 'select(.id=="DF-SPECLANG-014") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
jq -r 'select(.id=="DF-SPECLANG-1-R4") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; jq -r 'select(.id=="DF-SPECLANG-3") | .detail.evidence' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl

git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -cE 'history/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/[0-9a-f]{8}/verdict\.json$'; echo ---; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -E 'verdict\.json$' | grep -vE 'history/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/[0-9a-f]{8}/verdict\.json$' | head

jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .detail.text' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | grep -o "jq -r '[^']*'"; echo ===; jq -r '((.detail.evidence//[])[]|.run_id//empty)' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l

jq -r '((.detail.evidence//[])[]|.run_id//empty)' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl 2>/dev/null | sort -u > /tmp/runids.txt; wc -l /tmp/runids.txt; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -oE 'history/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/[0-9a-f]{8}' | cut -d/ -f3 | sort -u > /tmp/refids.txt; wc -l /tmp/refids.txt; echo "=== cited but NOT in ref ==="; comm -23 /tmp/runids.txt /tmp/refids.txt

LC_ALL=C sort -u /tmp/runids.txt > /tmp/runids.s.txt; LC_ALL=C sort -u /tmp/refids.txt > /tmp/refids.s.txt; echo "=== cited but NOT in ref ==="; LC_ALL=C comm -23 /tmp/runids.s.txt /tmp/refids.s.txt; echo "=== count ==="; LC_ALL=C comm -23 /tmp/runids.s.txt /tmp/refids.s.txt | wc -l

jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .status' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; grep -c '"id":"EVID-1"' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; grep -n 'EVID-1' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | cut -c1-120
git log --all --oneline --grep='EVID-1' | head; echo ===; git log --oneline e7839567..HEAD -- .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | head; echo ===; git show e7839567 --stat | head -20
git show 071ed739 --stat | head -10; echo ===; git show 071ed739 | head -60

git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -E 'history/[^/]+/[^/]+/verdict\.json$' | awk -F/ '{print $3}' | grep -vE '^[0-9a-f]{8}$'; echo "---non-8hex-dir-count-above---"; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -oE 'history/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}/[^/]+/verdict\.json$' | wc -l
git ls-remote origin 2>/dev/null | grep -i gitreins; echo ===; git for-each-ref refs/gitreins/ 2>/dev/null

git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -E 'verdict\.json$' | awk -F/ '{print $4}' | grep -vE '^[0-9a-f]{8}$'; echo "---non-8hex-runid-dirs-above---"; git ls-tree -r --name-only refs/gitreins/history | grep -E 'verdict\.json$' | awk -F/ '{print $4}' | sort -u | wc -l
git log --oneline 071ed739..refs/gitreins/history 2>/dev/null; echo ===; git show --stat refs/gitreins/history | head -15

git fetch origin refs/gitreins/history:refs/gitreins/history 2>&1; git rev-parse refs/gitreins/history; sh scripts/audit-evidence-runids.sh > /tmp/audit2.txt 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"; tail -8 /tmp/audit2.txt

git ls-tree -r --name-only 071ed739 | grep -E 'verdict\.json$' | awk -F/ '{print $4}' | sort -u > /tmp/origin_refids.txt; wc -l /tmp/origin_refids.txt; echo "=== cited but NOT in origin ref ==="; LC_ALL=C comm -23 /tmp/runids.s.txt /tmp/origin_refids.txt
ls .gitreins/history/2026-11-20/; echo ===; for d in .gitreins/history/2026-11-20/*/; do echo "$d"; done
grep -c '9559f941' /tmp/runids.s.txt; grep '9559f941' /tmp/audit2.txt

git show 4c97462c --stat | head -12; echo ===; git show 4c97462c:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .status' 2>/dev/null; echo ===; git show 5b7a1e00:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl 2>/dev/null | jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .status' 2>/dev/null
git show 5b7a1e00 --stat | tail -8; echo ===; git show 5b7a1e00 -- scripts/evidence_audit.sh | head -20; echo ===; ls -la scripts/ | grep -i evidence
git show 5b7a1e00 -- package.json | head -30; echo ===; grep -n 'audit' package.json
git show 5b7a1e00 | sed -n '30,80p'
jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .title' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl; echo ===; jq -r 'select(.id=="EVID-1") | .status, .updated_at, .sessions' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
grep -n 'gitreins' .gitignore; echo ===; git check-ignore -v .gitreins/history/2026-11-20/9559f941/verdict.json 2>&1; echo ===; git ls-files .gitreins/ | head
